title: Vegan Tofu Shawarma
subtitle: in a pita with tahini and salads
description: Meat-free shawarma with golden crispy tofu, browned onion and plenty of seasoning, cooked in one pan and stuffed into a pita with tahini, salads and pickles.

steps.text: Slice the onions into strips and fry in a little oil until softened, translucent and lightly golden.
Meanwhile, drain the tofu, wrap it in a clean towel and press well to remove as much liquid as possible.
Cut the tofu into thin strips and add to the pan with the onion.
Fry the tofu, stirring gently so it doesn't break, until lightly golden and crisp.
Mix all the seasoning ingredients in a bowl until combined.
Pour the seasoning into the pan and stir gently so the tofu and onion are well coated.
Keep frying for a few more minutes, until the liquid reduces and the shawarma turns a deep, rich brown.
Serve in a pita, flatbread or on a plate with tahini, salads, pickles and any other toppings you like.
